headline: Dr Tariq Jamil honoured with IEP Fellowship
excerpt: NC4SCM Principal Investigator Dr Tariq Jamil received the IEP Fellowship at the Institution of Engineers Pakistan’s 78th Foundation Ceremony and presented the impact and outcomes of GCGC 2025.

headline: GCGC 2025 advances green construction knowledge and LC³ demonstration
excerpt: The Global Conference on Green Construction Materials and Practices was held at NED UET on 5–6 February 2025 alongside the inauguration of Pakistan’s first structural demonstration of LC³.

headline: LC³ journey presented at HVACR Trends 5.0
excerpt: At HVACR Trends 5.0 in Karachi, Dr Tariq Jamil presented LC³ and joined discussions on academic research, capacity development, AI, innovation, and smart decarbonisation in Pakistan.

headline: Pakistan’s LC³ progress shared at EPFL workshop in Lausanne
excerpt: Dr Tariq Jamil joined the LC3 Project global team and EPFL workshop in Lausanne on 15–16 September 2025 to discuss sustainable construction materials and effective material use.

headline: LC³ Pakistan progress presented at ICEC 2024
excerpt: The latest progress of the LC³ project in Pakistan was presented at the International Conference on Civil Engineering, jointly organised by IEP and NED UET in Karachi.

headline: LC³ featured in national cement decarbonisation workshop
excerpt: LC³ was presented at the SPAR6C capacity-building workshop on decarbonising Pakistan’s cement sector, arranged by UNEP Copenhagen Climate Centre under the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment.

headline: LC³ showcased at Sindh HEC Research and Technology Showcase
excerpt: The LC³ team presented Pakistan’s locally developed low-carbon cement research at the Sindh HEC Research and Technology Showcase at Karachi Expo Centre on 19–20 May 2022.

headline: Research with the reach to reshape construction.
introduction: NC4SCM is a national platform connecting materials science, engineering practice, and industry implementation.
missionHeading: Achieve research excellence in low-carbon construction materials, and enable their application in industry and policy, for the benefit of society with integrity and wisdom.
visionHeading: Be a leader in enabling the region's transformation to low-carbon and affordable construction materials.

journey.title: Research Journey Began
journey.description: Received an HEC research grant and initiated nationwide clay exploration, material characterisation, and laboratory testing for LC³.

journey.title: Standardisation Milestone
journey.description: Following successful testing and validation, LC³ cement standardisation was approved in Pakistan, supporting its pathway towards practical adoption.

journey.title: National Industry Engagement
journey.description: Organised Pakistan’s first National Workshop on LC³, bringing together representatives from the cement industry across the country.

journey.title: First Structural Demonstration
journey.description: Constructed Pakistan’s first structural application of Limestone Calcined Clay Cement (LC³) at NED UET, demonstrating its practical feasibility beyond the laboratory.

journey.title: Global Knowledge Platform
journey.description: Organised the Global Conference on Green Construction Materials and Practices (GCGC 2025) at NED UET, connecting researchers, industry professionals, and sustainability stakeholders.

journey.title: Establishment of NC4SCM
journey.description: The journey culminated in the establishment of the National Center for Sustainable Construction Materials (NC4SCM) at NED UET, creating a dedicated platform for research, industrial implementation, and sustainable construction innovation.
